predictions.articleTitle: QPR vs Sheffield Utd Prediction & Match Analysis: Can QPR's xG Edge Overcome Defensive Absences?
predictions.coreRecommendation: QPR's 1.73 xG output and Loftus Road unbeaten record support a Home Win / Draw projection in an open, both-teams-to-score Championship contest.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 thesis (Home Win / Draw): QPR control chance creation and welcome back Nicolas Madsen against Sheffield Utd's depleted right flank, while QPR's defensive absences keep the Draw active (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

Secondary totals and BTTS thesis (Over 2.5 & BTTS: Yes): Combined 2.60 expected-goal baseline and high venue BTTS rates (62.5% QPR home, 75.0% Sheffield Utd away) favor 2:1 or 1:1 (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Contingency stalemate thesis (1:1 Draw): If QPR's 69.2% big-chance waste persists against returning Japhet Tanganga, Sheffield Utd's 37.5% set-piece threat can force a share of the points (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
